title: Clean pingx
description: Shows your current ping in milliseconds
body:
✨ Features

    Simple Command: Players can type a command (e.g., /ping) to see their latency immediately.

    Accurate Reporting: Fetches real-time latency directly from the server's connection handling.

    Lightweight: Minimal resource usage; perfect for Survival, PvP, and Minigame servers.

    No Client Mods Needed: Works for any player joining with a vanilla client.

🛠️ Installation

    Download the .jar file.

    Place it into your server's /plugins folder.

    Restart the server (or run a plugin loader).

    Grant the necessary permissions to your default group.

🔒 Permissions

    ping.use (or the specific node you coded): Allows access to the ping command.
